name: Marsh Reeve
languages: Common plus the languages it knew in life

abilities.name: Unerring Tracker
abilities.description: When the reeve follows a creature's trail, the reeve can follow the trail without a check, at its full speed, regardless of terrain, darkness, or the time elapsed, and cannot be misled by a false trail.

abilities.name: Incorporeal Movement
abilities.description: The reeve can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

abilities.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
abilities.description: While in sunlight, the reeve has disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

actions.name: Wading Strike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (5d8 + 4) necrotic damage.

condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

generation.userConcept: a reeve of the drowned marsh who never loses a trail

clauses.text: a reeve of the drowned marsh

generation.cite: composition after Wraith (CR 5) — Life Drain under the sunlight bane

other_edition.lore: A drowned reeve who refused to abandon a pursuit as the marsh water rose over him, his oath outliving his body so that he now wades the flooded bottoms forever, running down anything that flees with the cold patience that drowned him.
